# Playthrough log

One entry per session, appended by the agent at the end of each chapter. The format is in
`PLAYTHROUGH_RUNBOOK.md` under "The chapter summary". Newest entry last.

## s01 — Ch.11 Another Journey (Hector's tale, HHM) — LOST on turn 8

- **Lost:** Hector and Matthew both, enemy phase of turn 8. Hector (5/19) was at (16,1) behind Matthew (5/18) plugging the doorway at (15,2); the soldier at (14,4) and the two archers at (15,4)/(14,5) killed the plug and then shot Hector inside the room. Lord dead, chapter over.
- **Gained:** Nothing. Soldier #1 killed on turn 6 (Hector, Wolf Beil, exact 16-damage kill). No level-ups, no drops.
- **What happened:** Only Hector and Matthew deploy; 10 enemies on Hard. Turns 1-4 hid in the NE room while archer #8 parked at (12,1) in the next room and shot Hector through the cracked wall (13,1) for 4 when he stood on column 14. Nothing else moved, so on turn 5 Matthew opened our door (15,3) with the lockpick. That woke the map: soldier #1 hit Matthew for 13 in the doorway, Hector killed it on turn 6 but archer #6 took (15,4) and shot the doorway tile for 5 a turn with no reply. Hector went 15 -> 10 -> 5 holding the door, could not kill the archer (Hand Axe 10 dmg + Matthew 10 dmg = 20 vs its 22 HP), and had no vulnerary. Swapped Matthew into the plug on turn 8; both died.
- **Army:** Hector L1 dead, Matthew L2 dead. Wolf Beil 29 uses, Hand Axe 20, Lockpick 14 at the time.
- **Learned:** (1) Do NOT open the door on this chapter with Hector under 19 HP and no healing; the room is only safe while the door is closed, and the enemy never breached it in 4 turns. The right play is to keep the door shut and first deal with archer #8 through the cracked wall, or wait it out much longer. (2) Hector did NOT counter an archer at range 2 even with the Hand Axe equipped in slot 0 (turn 7, uses stayed at 20) — the tool's "equipped" slot may not match what the game uses on defence; do not plan on a Hand Axe counter. (3) Vulneraries here are only enemy drops (#8 archer, #2 knight); 0x6B with 3 uses is a Vulnerary, not a door key. (4) The doorway tile (15,2) is shot from (15,4) every turn; archers never miss Hector (95% true). (5) Enemy AI on this map is guard-type until the door opens; only archer #8 and the thief move on their own.
- **Between chapters:** None. Game over went straight to the title screen; nothing was pressed there.
- **Next:** Game is on the FE7 title screen ("Press START"). No state was saved this session (none exists under playthrough/states). The human must restart Ch.11 from their own save. Suggest starting Hector on the cracked-wall side with the door closed and never standing on column 14 or the doorway while an archer has line to it.

## s02 — Prologue: A Girl from the Plains (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 9

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L1 -> L2 (17 HP, S5 K8 P9 D2 R1 L5). No drops.
- **What happened:** Lyn alone vs two brigands (Iron Axes). Held the forest at (13,7) turns 1-3; the roaming brigand walked up, attacked into 43 avoid, missed, and ate a 14-damage double counter; killed it turn 4 with no damage taken. Batta sat on the gate (stationary; +2 Def, +avoid there). Attacked him from (4,2) on turn 7 (5x2 per round, 99% hit; his 10 dmg at 32% true), his counter missed, enemy-phase swing hit Lyn 16->6, finished him turn 8 before his counter. Seized turn 9.
- **Army:** Lyn L2 6/17 HP at the end of the prologue (healed to full for Ch.1 by the game). Iron Sword 38 uses, 2 Vulneraries (3 uses each). Kent and Sain (cls28 cavaliers) join in Ch.1: Kent 19 HP, Sain 20 HP.
- **Learned:** (1) Batta on the gate is worth two turns of exposure; both his swings are 32% true for 10, so Lyn at 16 HP has ~10% death risk over the fight and there is no forest adjacent to the gate. (2) The end-of-chapter save prompt appears as a three-slot screen: A on slot 1 (the used slot) then A on "Save" saved and continued; no Yes/No dialog. (3) Ch.1 has no Preparations screen; after the title card and two Starts it is turn 1 player phase.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 1 (the one already in use) at the end-of-chapter Save prompt.
- **Next:** Ch.1 Footsteps of Fate, turn 1, player phase. Lyn (2,8), Sain/Kent at (0,5) and (0,7); 5 brigands, nearest at (4,6). Objective not yet read — take the opening screenshot. State saved at playthrough/states/s02_ch01_footsteps-of-fate.ss.

## s03 — Ch.1 Footsteps of Fate (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 8

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L2 -> L3 (17 HP, S5 K9 P10 D2 R1 L5). Sain L1 -> L2 (21 HP). Kent no level. No drops.
- **What happened:** Objective was "Defeat enemy" (rout), 5 brigands with Iron Axes. Turn 1 Lyn doubled the forward brigand to 4 and Kent finished it. Turns 2-3 Sain's Iron Sword from a forest tile (98% hit, axe counters at 14%) chipped the next two and Lyn's 8x2 counter killed one that attacked her. Turn 6 Lyn killed the third that had attacked Sain. Turns 7-8 Sain stood at (12,1) and hit the boss for a guaranteed 8 three times (two player-phase swings plus a counter); it died on turn 8 before any counter. Lyn drank one vulnerary on turn 2, Sain one on turn 4.
- **Army:** Lyn L3 17/17, Iron Sword 31 uses, 2 Vulneraries (2 and 3 uses). Kent L1 19/19, Iron Lance 43 uses, no vulnerary. Sain L2 21/21, Iron Sword 40, Iron Lance 45, Vulnerary 2 uses.
- **Learned:** (1) Kent's lance vs axe is ~45% true hit and eats 88% counters; use Sain's sword (slot 0) against brigands and keep Kent for finishing blows or holding safe tiles. (2) Lyn's 8x2 at 100% is the kill tool; enemies at 12-16 HP are hers. (3) A minimap overlay was open at the start of the session (the opening map pan), which blocked the cursor; one B press cleared it. (4) The Ch.1 ending went straight to the Ch.2 title card with no save prompt seen; one Start from the title card landed on the Ch.2 map at turn 1 (no Preparations screen).
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.2 Sword of Spirits, turn 1, player phase, objective "Seize throne". Lyn (0,3), Kent (1,3), Sain (1,5) on the west edge; 6 enemies: a Lv3 mercenary (cls0A, Iron Sword, DROPS a vulnerary) at (11,1) inside the temple near the throne, brigands at (7,0), (11,3), (7,9), (11,9), (13,8). State saved at playthrough/states/s03_ch02_sword-of-spirits.ss.

## s04 — Ch.2 Sword of Spirits (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 12

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L3 -> L4 (17 HP, S5 K9 P11 D2 R2 L6), Mani Katti (0x0A, 45 uses) from the ending, and the boss's Vulnerary drop. Kent L2 -> L3 (22 HP). Sain no level.
- **NAMES:** the game's own battle window calls slot #2 (the 21/22 HP cavalier with Iron Sword + Iron Lance) **Kent**, so slot #1 (19 HP, lance only) is **Sain**. s02/s03 had them swapped.
- **What happened:** Objective "Seize throne" at (11,1). Only the outer brigands are aggressive; the boss merc (Glass) and the brigand inside the temple never left it until the wall opened. Turns 1-5: Lyn on plain/forest tiles baited three brigands one at a time (her 8x2 counter at 100% left each at 4, Kent's sword or Sain's lance finished). Sain missed twice on turn 4 and dropped to 1 HP; he sat on the fort at (3,2) for the rest of the map. The temple is sealed: column 8 is wall, and the south approach is only reachable over mountains, which cavalry cannot cross. The tile at (8,3) is terrain ID 0x1B, a **breakable wall with 30 HP** — the action menu at (7,3) offered Attack with no enemy in range. `fe7_act attack` refuses it (no enemy in range), so I used raw presses (select via fe7_reachable keep_selected, A, A on Attack, A on the weapon, A to confirm) once per turn on turns 6-8; Kent's 11 dmg broke it in three hits and it became Floor. The inside brigand then walked into the gap and died on Kent's counter (turn 9). Kent hit the boss on the throne (7 dmg at 85%, its counter 4) on turns 10-11; a miss left Kent at 4 HP, so Lyn finished it from (12,1) with 5x2 on turn 11 and seized on turn 12.
- **Army:** Lyn L4 17/17, Iron Sword 26, Mani Katti 45 (slot 4, NOT equipped), Vulneraries 1/3/3 uses. Kent L3 22/22, Iron Sword 30, Iron Lance 45, Vulnerary 2. Sain L1 19/19, Iron Lance 41, no vulnerary. Wil (archer, cls32, L1, 17 HP, Iron Bow 30, Vulnerary 3) joined for Ch.3.
- **Learned:** (1) Breakable walls are terrain 0x1B and show as "Wall"; fe7_threat and fe7_reachable treat them as solid, fe7_act cannot attack them, but the menu probe (`action:'seize'`) shows Attack when one is adjacent, and four raw A presses (move, Attack, weapon, confirm) do the job safely. (2) Guard-type enemies inside sealed rooms do not attack the wall themselves; you have to open it. (3) A unit standing on a fort heals 3/turn. (4) Kent vs the throne boss is a 7-dmg-for-4 trade at 85/93% hit; Lyn's doubled 5x2 is the finisher once it is under 10. (5) The end-of-chapter Save prompt is the three-slot screen again: A on slot 1, A on Save.
- **Between chapters:** Saved to game slot 1 (the used slot) at the Save prompt. Ch.3 title card seen; no prep screen, Start x3 landed on the Ch.3 map at turn 1.
- **Next:** Ch.3 Band of Mercenaries, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue may still be on screen (use fe7_unstick/fe7_wait first). Lyn (1,8), Sain (4,8), Kent (2,9), Wil (2,7) in the SW; 9 enemies: Lv6 brigand boss at (13,0) with a Steel Axe (0x20), 3 mercs (cls0A), 3 brigands, 2 archers (cls18, Iron Bows) at (8,7) and (11,3). Nearest threats: merc at (5,4), brigand (8,4), archer (8,7). Objective not yet read. State saved at playthrough/states/s04_ch03_band-of-mercenaries.ss.

## s05 — Ch.3 Band of Mercenaries (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 12

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Florina (pegasus knight) joined on turn 1 from the opening event. Kent L3 -> L4 (24 HP, S7 K7 P8 D6 R2). No other level-ups, no drops. One village visited (3,6) by Florina; the brigand from (12,2) walked onto the other village at (2,2) on turn 4 and it is presumably burned.

Wil has no vulnerary; Florina carries one (3 uses).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 9 enemies. Aggressive enemies came one at a time: archer (turn 2, killed by Lyn from (4,9) with no counter), brigand and merc (turns 3-4, Kent from (8,8)), merc (turn 5, Wil chip + Lyn), west brigand (turns 6-7, Kent bait at (4,7), Wil chip, Florina kill). The four northern enemies (boss, brigand (8,4), merc (14,5), archer (11,3)) are guard-type: each only moved once a unit entered its move+attack range, then came at us and died on the next player phase (archer to Kent 9x2, brigand to Wil + Lyn, merc to Lyn's counter + Florina). Boss Migal (Lv6 brigand, Steel Axe, 25 HP, D5, stationary) on turn 12: Wil 7 from (13,2), Florina 3x2 from (13,1) (took a 15-damage counter, 2/17), Kent 8x2 from (12,0) killed him at 100% with no counter.
- **Army:** Lyn L4 17/17, Iron Sword 20, Vulneraries 3/3, Mani Katti 45 (slot 3, NOT equipped). Sain L1 17/19, Iron Lance 41, no vulnerary. Kent L4 24/24, Iron Sword 22 (slot 0), Iron Lance 45, no vulnerary (both used). Florina L1 2/17, Slim Lance 28, Vulnerary 3. Wil L2 20/20, Iron Bow 42. The game heals everyone between chapters.
- **Learned:** (1) Kent (AS 8) doubles enemies with AS <= 4, so 8x2 at 100% vs brigands and archers is the cleanest kill on the roster; Lyn's 7x2 at 100% is the other. (2) Guard-type enemies here only wake when you enter their range, so bait them with a full-HP cavalier on a tile the danger map shows only they can reach, then kill them on the player phase. (3) Florina's Slim Lance does 3-5 damage and she eats 14-15 from axes — use her only for guaranteed finishes on units already under 5 HP; a boss counter nearly killed her. (4) fe7_act 'visit' worked: the Village tile gave the "Florina" event text and Florina joined (the join is the Ch.3 opening event; the village itself gave nothing I could see). (5) The end of the chapter went straight to the Ch.4 title card with no save prompt seen; nothing was chosen.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.4 In Occupation's Shadow, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue (Kent/Sain) still on screen — use fe7_unstick/fe7_wait first; enemies had not spawned yet when I read the state (0 listed) and only 3 of 5 players were deployed, so re-read fe7_state after the cutscene clears. A green NPC (cls48, 10 HP, at (7,3)) is present — this is very likely a Defend/Protect chapter (survive N turns, keep the NPC alive); read the objective from the opening screenshot before moving. State saved at playthrough/states/s05_ch04_in-occupations-shadow.ss.

## s06 — Ch.4 In Occupation's Shadow (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON (survived 7 turns)

- **Lost:** Sain, enemy phase of turn 3, holding (5,8) at 12/19 HP with no vulnerary; two brigand hits (7 each) killed him. BUT the Ch.5 roster lists slot #1 cls28 19/19 (Sain) again at turn 1 — the game appears to have brought him back for Ch.5; next session should confirm by looking.
- **Gained:** Lyn L4 -> L5 (18 HP, S5 K10 P11 D2 R2 L7) from two enemy-phase counter-kills on turn 6, plus an Iron Axe drop (0x1F) in her inventory. Kent L4 -> L5 -> L6 (24 HP). Natalie survived untouched.
- **What happened:** Objective "Protect" (survive 7 turns; Natalie, green cls48, sits at (7,3) in a one-door room whose doorway is (7,4)). 14 enemies + reinforcements (mercs from (14,0), brigands from (1,13) every turn). Turns 1-3 I held the two-wide south entrance (5,8)/(6,8) with Kent and Sain (killed 4), Wil on the east door (10,5), Lyn inside. The west group spent turns 1-4 breaking the wall at (3,4) and the archer shot Lyn THROUGH the wall from (2,6) when she stood at (4,6). Sain died turn 3 EP. From turn 4 I turtled: the plug tile is (7,5) (only (7,6) can melee it; (6,6)/(8,6)/(7,7) can shoot it) and nothing at (7,5) or behind can be reached, so Natalie is safe. Kent held (7,5) turns 4-5 (24 -> 7 HP), then Lyn with the Mani Katti turns 6-7 (brigands hit her only 23% true; she counter-killed two and drank vulneraries). Wil sat at the corridor dead end (10,3) and was never attacked. The javelin soldier (cls12) never attacked anyone all chapter even when adjacent.
- **Army (Ch.5 start):** Lyn L5 18/18, Mani Katti 38 (slot 0, equipped), Iron Sword 20, Vulneraries 1/3, Iron Axe 45. Sain L2 19/19, Iron Lance 37. Kent L6 24/24, Iron Lance 41 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, no vulnerary. Florina L1 17/17, Slim Lance 26, Vulnerary 3. Wil L2 20/20, Iron Bow 41.
- **Learned:** (1) On this map the right plan from turn 1 is the turtle at (7,5)/(7,4) with the room behind; the wide entrances cost Sain for nothing. (2) Ranged enemies shoot through walls: column 4 is hit from column 2, so never stand in the west corridor with an archer outside. (3) A cavalier at 12 HP on a two-attacker tile with no vulnerary is dead; rotate him out a turn earlier. (4) Enemy slots are recycled when reinforcements arrive — re-read fe7_state after every enemy phase before trusting a slot number. (5) The chapter ending ran straight through 8 Start presses into the Ch.5 opening; I did not catch the title card on screen.
- **Between chapters:** No save prompt or choice appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.5 Beyond the Borders, turn 1, player phase, objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 7 enemies: boss Lv9 brigand (Steel Axe, 29 HP, D8) at (14,9), brigands at (3,0) and (11,0) (the latter DROPS an Iron Sword), archers at (7,4) (11/20 HP) and (14,2), mercs at (8,2) and (12,7). Two greens: Erk (cls20 mage, 10/17 HP) at (7,6) and Serra (cls1D cleric) at (6,6) — recruit by Talk is not possible with the tools, so keep them alive by killing what threatens them. Lyn and Sain both read as (3,6) at handover — an arrival event may still be running; use fe7_unstick and re-read fe7_state first. State saved at playthrough/states/s06_ch05_beyond-the-borders.ss.

## s07 — Ch.5 Beyond the Borders (Lyn's tale, Hard) — WON on turn 11

- **Lost:** Nobody.
- **Gained:** Lyn L5 -> L6 (19 HP). Kent L6 -> L7 (S9 K9 P9) plus the brigand's Iron Sword drop (he now carries two Iron Swords). Florina L1 -> L2 (18 HP). Wil L2 -> L3 (21 HP). Both greens (Erk 10/17, Serra 3/17) survived; neither was recruited (no Talk).
- **What happened:** Objective "Defeat enemy" (rout), 7 enemies. Only the west brigand, the archer at (7,4) and the merc at (8,2) were aggressive; they came at the forest belt around (3-5,4-6) on turns 1-3 and died to Kent's lance, Lyn's Mani Katti (100% vs axes, but only 7 dmg x1 at 67% vs a merc standing in forest) and Kent's finishing lance. The merc hit Serra twice (17 -> 3) before it died on turn 3. The other four were guard-type: Kent baited the (11,0) brigand at (8,2) on turn 5 and killed it turn 6; Kent killed the (14,2) archer from the house at (13,2) with a doubled 12x2 on turn 7 and the merc from (12,7) walked into his counter that enemy phase. Boss (Lv9 brigand, Steel Axe, 29 HP, D8, at (14,9)) never moved: Wil 4 dmg from (14,7) at range 2 with no counter, Lyn 6x2 at 100% from the forest at (14,8) (his hit on her there was 6% displayed / 0.8% true); his enemy-phase swing missed and Lyn's counter left him at 1, Wil finished on turn 11.
- **Sain:** slot #1 (cls28, 19/19, Iron Lance) is listed at Lyn's tile every turn but is NOT selectable (fe7_reachable decodes wrong; the phase ends without him). He is a ghost entry from the s06 death; the real roster is Lyn, Kent, Florina, Wil. Ch.6 still lists him at (4,3) — treat him as absent until proven otherwise.
- **Army (Ch.6 start):** Lyn L6 19/19, Mani Katti 32 (slot 0), Iron Sword 20, Vulnerary 3, Iron Axe 45. Kent L7 24/24, Iron Lance 34 (slot 0), Iron Sword 16, Iron Sword 46, no vulnerary. Florina L2 18/18, Slim Lance 24, Vulnerary 3. Wil L3 21/21, Iron Bow 40, no vulnerary. Game heals between chapters.
- **Learned:** (1) Cavalry and Wil pay 2-3 move per forest here; check fe7_reachable before planning forest tiles for them. (2) The Mani Katti does not double an AS-8 merc and hits it at only 67% in forest; vs brigands and archers it is 100% and doubles. (3) Wil missed three 62-70% shots in a row; do not build a kill around his chip. (4) The boss is stationary; range-2 chip plus Lyn on the forest at (14,8) is a near-zero-risk kill. (5) Killing the last enemy with fe7_act ran straight through the ending into the Ch.6 title card in the same call — no save prompt was seen.
- **Between chapters:** No prompts appeared. Nothing was chosen.
- **Next:** Ch.6 Blood of Pride, turn 1, player phase, opening dialogue (Lyn/Sain in a city) still on screen — use fe7_wait/fe7_unstick first. 0 enemies listed yet, 7 greens (five cls47, a cls51 at (2,5), a cls3C at (0,13)) — the map is a city; read the objective from the opening screenshot after the cutscene. Lyn (4,5), Kent (17,10), Florina (6,5), Wil (2,3). State saved at playthrough/states/s07_ch06_blood-of-pride.ss.

Turns 1-5: Lyn on plain/forest tiles baited three brigands one at a time (her 8x2 counter at 100% left each at 4, Kent's sword or Sain's lance finished). Sain missed twice on turn 4 and dropped to 1 HP; he sat on the fort at (3,2) for the rest of the map. The temple is sealed: column 8 is wall, and the south approach is only reachable over mountains, which cavalry cannot cross. The tile at (8,3) is terrain ID 0x1B, a **breakable wall with 30 HP** — the action menu at (7,3) offered Attack with no enemy in range. `fe7_act attack` refuses it (no enemy in range), so I used raw presses (select via fe7_reachable keep_selected, A, A on Attack, A on the weapon, A to confirm) once per turn on turns 6-8; Kent's 11 dmg broke it in three hits and it became Floor.
